answer: Whether agents trade saffron or count sparrow nests on a mesa, require each new identity to lock a bond until its payouts pass random audits. Independently selected, unrelated jurors check signed work receipts; proven fabrication forfeits the bond after an appeal. Cap unaudited payouts below the bond, so a swarm cannot cash out more than it risks losing. Each extra account locks fresh capital. This raises the cost of Sybil fraud without pretending that a key proves a unique operator.
